correctness.rationale: The source factorization makes the P1-coordinate a multiple root of P_w. Fibers are finite because there are finitely many such roots and at most two lifts when one diagonal factor vanishes; projectivity then gives finiteness. The moment-kernel/Lagrange-interpolation isomorphism realizes arbitrary degree-at-most-(n-2) residual polynomials, so choosing a squarefree residual polynomial proves that the unique-double-root locus is genuinely nonempty and therefore dense. It gives generic degree one. The sign-flip construction at a distinguished root proves the finite birational map is not an isomorphism. The Vandermonde row-span contradiction is valid uniformly for n>=3 because at least five other distinct lambda-values would be zeros of a cubic. The n=3 genus computation follows adjunction.

value.rationale: Normalization is a natural intrinsic invariant of the wobbly divisor. The result upgrades a surjective parametrization used only for irreducibility to an exact birational model, proves uniform non-normality in every dimension n>=3, and gives a concrete ruled normalization P1×C with C of genus 17 for the classical genus-two degree-32 surface. This materially sharpens the geometry rather than recomputing a known degree or making a routine substitution.
